# Artha source attribution

The raw banking dataset is from **The Artha Personal-Finance Reasoning Benchmark**, created by **Tejashwar Reddy Katika**, 2026.

- Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Tej-Katika/artha-benchmark
- Dataset DOI: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/9387
- Accompanying preprint: *Artha: A Domain Ontology-Driven Agentic Framework for LLM-Based Personal Finance Reasoning*, https://ssrn.com/abstract=6885058
- Dataset card license: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

The banking JSON in this starter package is unchanged. No Artha analysis, model, evaluation code, or dashboard is presented as this project's implementation. Original source license text and citation metadata are retained alongside this notice as `ARTHA_LICENSE.txt` and `ARTHA_CITATION.cff`.

The source's component license distinguishes CC BY 4.0 data/documentation from MIT-licensed code. The original license applies to the upstream materials; this notice does not relicense third-party data.

The source inspection notes and project documentation are newly written for this independent learning project. Any future transformation or synthetic augmentation must be documented separately.
